=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6440-6450 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A later validation record with raw_status="error" / raw_conclusion="failure" (or bare "harness_error" token) is treated as blocking, yet mark_validation_failed short-circuits budget/judge-fingerprint updates for harness_error.
  WHY: Terminal validation-failure cases (including harness_error) reach the ready-to-merge promotion path with the history gate still false, so EAGER_DRAFT_PR_PROMOTED never fires -> integration branch stays in limbo.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11288 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Cache-clear + re-population occurs per tracking issue, but maybe_apply_force_merge_bypass, check-wave-status, and the /revalidate handler can all run in the same poll cycle.
  WHY: The first path that sees the label wins the cache; subsequent paths see stale data and silently skip the bypass audit comment/memory record, leading to inconsistent operator-bypass records for the same integration SHA.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11688 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `wc -c` output is not validated as numeric before arithmetic test (contrast with the guard added to post_issue_comment_json).
  WHY: On any wc failure (locale, permission, truncation, pipe error) `body_bytes` becomes non-numeric, the guard is bypassed, and an oversized (or malformed) state comment can be posted, corrupting the orchestrator tracking comment chain.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:607 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Boolean sentinels supplied in revalidate_event / operator_bypass entries are normalised to null instead of being rejected or preserved.
  WHY: Deterministic audit records lose their boolean fields on write, downstream readers see inconsistent data, and the contract that memory entries are round-trippable is broken.
- agents.md:200-206 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The newly-added contractual prefixes (`EAGER_DRAFT_PR_CREATED`, `EAGER_DRAFT_PR_PROMOTED`, `INTEGRATION_STALE_ALERT_SENT`, `HARNESS_ERROR_DETECTED`, `FORCE_MERGE_BYPASS`, `BACKPRESSURE_TRIGGERED`, `BACKPRESSURE_CLEARED`) are listed but the downstream workflow-log-analysis pipeline (scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py, drift-audit.yml, etc.) still hard-codes the old set.
  WHY: Telemetry from these new paths is invisible to optimisation reports and alerts until the analysis scripts are updated.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: No call to ensure_eager_final_pr (nor update_eager_pr_validation_status_section) from the "validating" branch or the staleness check that runs every tick; the eager-PR logic is only reachable after ready-to-merge. LAST RUN DIFF / PR DIFF contain none of the promised pre-validation creation.
- requirement: "Per-SHA validation outcomes are persisted on the ai-memory branch and consulted before promoting ai:validated → ai:ready-to-merge" (AC4; same plan)
  expected_change_site: finalize_integration_merge_if_needed + the judge verdict path that promotes the draft PR (orchestrate_poll_process.sh ~6440 and ~6471)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The validation_history_gate_decision_for_current_sha predicate exists, but the promotion path still short-circuits for status=failed / ai:validation-failed before the gate is consulted (see the added project_is_validation_origin_terminal_failure guard). The eager PR therefore never sees a "pass" history record for harness-failure cases.
- requirement: "Harness failures are now handled as a distinct validation class [...] without burning the normal validation-recovery budgets" (AC2; same plan)
  expected_change_site: mark_validation_failed + the validation_history append before the harness_error short-circuit (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7033-7075)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The short-circuit is present, but the new `infer_validation_raw_status` + bare-token handling added in this run still leaves some harness_error paths burning judge fingerprint count (the `JUDGE_FINGERPRINT_REPEAT_COUNT` increment at ~11668 was not fully gated).
